description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically related to the Administration module, and handles the repairing of activities by recalculating and updating the end dates for calls and meetings that are not marked as 'Held'. It includes functions for date calculations, database queries to fetch open calls and meetings, and updates their end dates accordingly.

methods.name: calculateEndDate
methods.description: Calculates the end date based on start date and duration, validating DateTime objects and logging warnings or errors when necessary.
